integrity: A proof and direct finite enumerator are provided; finite checks are not substitutes for the unrestricted proof or external review.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of initial colors and complete multipartite graphs with r>=3; total-variation estimate requires all graph part shares uniformly below one. The rate constant is not optimal. Conditional on the published random-ordering reduction; monochrome and bipartite special cases are prior work. No priority guarantee against unindexed literature.
title: Sharp colored-peak limits for random stabilization on complete multipartite graphs
